answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 42425 Country: India Title: I just want to know that the holy Prophet Muhammad (saw) is a bashar or not Question: I just want to know that the holy Prophet Muhammad (saw) is a bashar or not? I have heard from Maulana Jarjis’s bayan that Allah Ne Kahlwa Diya Hai Ki "Kul Innama Anna Basharum Mislukum" so is it correct? I have heard that he is a Syed-ul Bashar. Please guide me in this regard. Answer ID: 42425 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1125/1107/N=1433) Yes, the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) is not only a Bashar (human being) rather he is Sayyadul Bashar. It is not right in any way to refuse the bashariyat of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم), it is against the Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
